intro.title: Why a snag list matters
paragraphs: A snag list records the defects and unfinished work in a new home so the builder can put them right. A clear list, with a photo of every item, is far easier for a builder to work through than a list of notes.
Our inspections are carried out by people who work in construction every day. We explain what each item is and why it matters, so you know what to ask the builder for.

price.headline: Snag inspection prices, including VAT
price.note: Prices include VAT and travel within 50 km of Dunshaughlin, Co. Meath.

process.title: Book
process.text: Message Wanessa on WhatsApp, call, or use the booking form. Tell us the address, the number of bedrooms and the date you would like.

process.title: Inspection
process.text: We inspect the home room by room and photograph each defect. If you cannot be there, we go through the findings with you afterwards.

process.title: Photo report
process.text: You receive a clear report with a photo and description of every issue. Reviews mention reports arriving within a day or two.

process.title: Send it to the builder
process.text: Forward the report to your builder or developer so the defects can be put right.

process.title: Re-snag if you want it
process.text: Once the repairs are done, we can come back and check the items on the list.

faqs.q: How much does a snag inspection cost?
faqs.a: €280 for a 2 bedroom home, €300 for 3 bedrooms, €350 for 4 bedrooms and €400 for 5 bedrooms. Prices include VAT and travel within 50 km of Dunshaughlin; beyond that, add €50.
Wanessa leads the snagging service and is your contact from booking to report. Inspections are carried out by our property inspection team.

faqs.q: Do I need to be there?
faqs.a: It helps if you can attend, but it is not essential. If you cannot be there, we go through the findings with you once the inspection is done.

faqs.q: What do I do with the report?
faqs.a: Send it to your builder or developer. Each item has a photo and a description, so the builder can see exactly what needs fixing.

faqs.q: Can you check the repairs afterwards?
faqs.a: Yes. A re-snag after the builder's repairs is available and quoted when you book.

faqs.q: Can you measure the rooms at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. Room measurements can be added to your inspection for €200.

cta.title: Book your snag inspection
cta.text: Send Wanessa the address, the number of bedrooms and your preferred date on WhatsApp, or use the booking form.

sections.title: Re-snag after the builder's repairs
paragraphs: Once the builder has worked through the list, we can return and check each item again. Re-snag is available and quoted when you book.

sections.title: Room measurements
paragraphs: While we are in the house, we can measure every room, which is useful when you plan flooring, blinds and furniture. Room measurements cost €200.
